title: Starter templates: Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP + CLI focused on streaming ergonomics and robust retries
creator: Maya Chen
description: Provide a compact, production-oriented starter pack of SDK examples and cookbook snippets that demonstrate: 1) streaming ergonomics across TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs (browser + server), 2) robust retry patterns and idempotency keys for safe retries, and 3) lightweight starter apps (Next.js SSR/edge streaming, FastAPI long-poll/async endpoints, Go HTTP server with SSE/HTTP2 + CLI). Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for engineers adopting Redwood SDKs and surface best practices for latency-sensitive, cost-conscious inference flows.
acceptance_criteria: Four runnable example apps (Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, language-agnostic CLI) with README quickstarts
Each example contains explicit streaming usage demonstrating: TypeScript async iterators (web + node), Python async generators, Go channels with cancel/timeout support
Retry primitives documented and implemented in examples: exponential backoff with jitter, idempotency keys, max retry window, and safe streaming reconnection patterns
Cookbook snippets for common patterns: prefix caching, resumable responses, partial-result merges, and batching recommendations
Automated tests (smoke) for example flows that run in CI (mocked runtime) and a smoke PR that validates build + example start
Docs link in repo and a short SDK blog draft (internal) summarizing trade-offs and performance expectations
tasks: Design quickstart content and directory layout for examples
Implement Next.js example: streaming SSR page + edge function sample using SDK streaming API
Implement FastAPI example: async endpoint streaming responses and background task reconnection guidance
Implement Go HTTP example: SSE/HTTP2 server, client example using 'net/http' and Go SDK, demonstrate channel-based stream consumption
Implement language-agnostic CLI example (Go CLI using Cobra + Python CLI using Click + node CLI) showing streaming to terminal and file checkpointing
Add retry helper utilities to SDK samples: backoff with jitter, idempotency key generator, request-level metadata headers
Write cookbook snippets: resumable streaming pseudocode, batch sizing table, header-based routing example
Create CI job to run examples with a local mocked Redwood runtime and smoke tests
Collect reviewer feedback and iterate on ergonomics (esp. TS async iterator API surface)
